name: Noteshrink
description: Cleans up scans and photos of notes and documents by reducing them to a few colours: removes paper texture, bleed-through and noise, and makes the files much smaller.

clean.name: Clean up scan
clean.description: Reduces the image to a few colours: a uniform background and the colours of the writing. Writes a PNG image.
clean.info: I tried to clean up scanned image.

num_colors.name: Number of colours
num_colors.help: Colours in the result, background included (2-64). Use 2 for black-and-white text; more for coloured pens or stamps.

value_threshold.name: Background brightness threshold (%)
value_threshold.help: How much darker than the paper a pixel must be to count as writing. Raise it when paper texture or shadows remain; lower it when faint writing disappears.

sat_threshold.name: Background colour threshold (%)
sat_threshold.help: How much more colourful than the paper a pixel must be to count as writing. Raise it when coloured paper shows through.

white_bg.name: White background
white_bg.help: Make the background pure white instead of the paper's colour.

saturate.name: Strengthen colours
saturate.help: Stretch the colours of the writing to full contrast.
